results.text: The historical baseline for April is partial history:  3  prior months,  2024-01  to  2024-03 , not an initialization row. April's completed-as-planned rate sat above its own prior-month mean ( +4.57  percentage points) but below the same-category mean of  86.12%  for the same month. The two measures say different things: completion is about flights operated as planned, release normality is about departure regularity — both are reported, neither replaces the other.
